area: Area 1: built-in and contrib text search
current_formulation: Text search is part of the core server, configured by SQL commands, and the tsearch2 compatibility module is gone.

steps.formulation: contrib/tsearch adds the type txtidx with a GiST index, as a first step towards OpenFTS inside PostgreSQL.
steps.quote: Tsearch contrib module contains implementation of new data type txtidx

criticism.quote: We didn't try to implement a full-featured search engine with stable interfaces but rather experiment with various approaches.

steps.formulation: contrib/tsearch2 adds tsvector, tsquery, configuration tables, and the rank functions rank and rank_cd.
steps.quote: Tsearch2 - is the full text engine, fully integrated into PostgreSQL RDBMS.

steps.formulation: Text search moves into the core server in 8.3, configured by SQL commands, with dictionary files in one directory.
steps.quote: search is configured through the specialized SQL commands shown earlier in this chapter

steps.formulation: Release 10 removes the contrib/tsearch2 compatibility module.
